full_prompt_en: A square decorative storybook image places a fair young woman in profile at the center of a dense dark garden. Her blond hair is smoothly parted and tied into a low bun. She faces right, with a small straight nose, light cheek blush, and a quiet attentive expression. A narrow golden crown or comb rises just above her head. She wears a cream high-neck blouse under a dark forest-green sleeveless dress and a pale green apron with little botanical motifs near its pocket. Both hands support a pale gray rabbit held horizontally at waist level. The animal faces right with long ears laid back, a round bright eye, and slender forepaws resting over her hand. Around them, the entire background is filled with stylized plants, fruits, and flowers on nearly black ground. Large round leaves, orange and red fruits, pale green seed heads, ochre blossoms, yellow globe flowers, and thin curling stems overlap in an intricate repeating pattern. An arching vine or black curved border frames the upper portion. The woman and rabbit are drawn with smooth pale shapes and precise edges, clearly separated from the darker vegetal density. The colors are muted and earthy: black-green, sage, ochre, mustard, terracotta, ivory, and blond gold. Fine lines describe hair, leaf veins, fabric pleats, and petal centers; flat shapes and gentle grain keep the finish printed and handmade. There is little spatial depth or horizon. The figure is integrated into the floral field as part of a visual tapestry, while the rabbit's pale body makes a second light focal area. No readable text appears. The scene is calm, slightly formal, and fanciful, balancing simple human posture against abundant ornamental nature.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形装饰性故事书图像把一位肤色白皙的年轻女子侧身放在繁密深暗花园中央。金发整齐分开，在后方扎成低髻。她朝右，有小巧直鼻、淡淡面颊红晕与安静专注的神情。窄窄金色冠饰或发梳在头顶稍稍升起。她穿奶油色高领衬衫、深森林绿无袖裙和浅绿围裙，围裙口袋旁有小植物记号。双手在腰部水平托着一只浅灰兔子。动物朝右，长耳向后伏，有圆亮眼睛，细前爪搭在她手上。四周近黑背景被风格化植物、果实与花朵填满。大圆叶、橙红果实、浅绿种球、赭黄花、黄色圆花与细卷茎在繁复重复纹样中重叠。一条弯曲藤蔓或黑弧边框住上部。女子与兔子由平滑浅色形与精确边缘画出，清楚从较暗植物密度中分离。色彩低饱和而朴素：黑绿、鼠尾草绿、赭、芥黄、陶红、象牙与金发色。细线描绘头发、叶脉、衣褶和花心；平面形状与轻颗粒使成品有印刷和手工气。几乎没有空间深度或地平线。人物像视觉织毯的一部分融入花域，兔子的浅色身体形成第二亮焦点。没有可读文字。场面安静、略正式又带奇想，在简单人体姿态与丰盛装饰自然之间保持平衡。
style_prompt_en: The ornamental storybook style places smooth pale focal shapes within a densely patterned near-black botanical field. Sage, forest green, mustard, ochre, terracotta, ivory, and soft gold remain muted and earthy. Flat plantlike forms overlap with little conventional depth, making the whole image feel woven or printed. Thin precise lines mark veins, curls, pleats, and tiny centers, while gentle grain softens the flat fills. An arched upper border gathers the repeated leaves, round fruits, and small blossoms into a contained tapestry. Light areas are reserved for a few calm central forms; the surrounding abundance stays darker and more intricate. Edges are controlled, expressions and gestures understated, and the mood quiet, folkloric, and gently fanciful.
style_prompt_zh: 装饰性故事书风格把平滑浅色焦点形放进纹样密集的近黑植物画域。鼠尾草绿、森林绿、芥黄、赭、陶红、象牙与柔金保持低饱和、朴素。平面植物般形状重叠，却少有常规纵深，使全图像织出或印出的布面。细而精确的线标记脉络、卷曲、褶皱和微小中心，柔和颗粒缓和平涂。上方弧形边界把重复叶、圆果与小花聚成受控织毯。浅色只留给少数安静中央形体；周围丰盛元素更暗更繁。边缘受控，神情与手势克制，气氛安静、民俗且温和奇想。
theme_en: A blond woman in a dark green dress holds a pale rabbit amid a dense fruit-and-flower garden
theme_zh: 金发女子穿深绿裙抱着浅色兔子，周围是繁密果实与花卉花园
name: Sophie Blackall
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
